name: Path of the Sword
summary: In so much uncertainty, you take matters into your own hands. You pick up the sword and make a resolve to learn.

steps.journal: Falcon told me to meet him at the Training Grounds, the old stone circle west of town. The first art is the blade: close, fast, and honest.

objectives.text: Meet Falcon at the Training Grounds

steps.journal: Falcon gave me a shortsword. Equip it, put a Brawler skill on my bar, then cut down the mice in Mouse Meadow, east of the circle. Get close, strike, step away.
Six mice. My arm aches, but I'm still standing. Falcon will want to hear about it.
